sources.snippet: Transforming passive reading into an interactive learning journey, Peek-A-Word turns selected text into AI-generated visuals. Concise definitions and contextual imagery are generated in one space, without any distracting tab-switching to disturb flow of learning with Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite.
